typhoon.note: Typhoon behaviour is not a fixed date. Hong Kong Observatory raises signals; T8 and above closes most retail and all outdoor production. These are the working rules the layer applies to any activation date.
rules: Signal 1 or 3: outdoor installs paused, indoor continues
Signal 8 or above: site closed, no shooting, no installs, no deliveries
Signal lowered to 3: allow two hours to reopen
Black rainstorm: same as signal 8 for outdoor work

season.note: Typhoon season overlaps the whole activation year. Keep a two week buffer on any outdoor build between May and November.
